boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-extra-cost ways for eligible George Fox students to exercise and spend time together at Hadlock Student Center or the neighboring aquatic center.

cards.entity_name: Pickup Basketball at Willie Stoffer Gymnasium
cards.title: Start a Pickup Basketball Game
cards.subtitle: Willie Stoffer Gymnasium · Hadlock Student Center
cards.notes: Bring your George Fox ID, check court availability at the welcome desk, and invite friends into a pickup game.
cards.short_summary: Use one of Hadlock’s three multi-use courts for a casual basketball hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock is open to eligible current George Fox undergraduates, and its gym provides three courts for basketball; basketballs can be checked out with a valid university ID.
cards.access_notes: Eligible current undergraduates enter with a current George Fox ID after signing the campus waiver; courts are first-come, first-served.

cards.entity_name: Open Volleyball at Willie Stoffer Gymnasium
cards.title: Set Up an Open Volleyball Rally
cards.subtitle: Willie Stoffer Gymnasium · Hadlock Student Center
cards.notes: Ask the welcome desk about an open court and volleyball setup, then gather a group for cooperative rallies or a game.
cards.short_summary: Turn an available Hadlock court into a no-purchase volleyball session.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock’s multi-use courts support volleyball, and eligible students may ask welcome-desk staff to set up volleyball equipment.
cards.access_notes: Use requires eligible Hadlock access, a signed campus waiver, and a current university ID; ask staff before setting up volleyball.

cards.title: Trade Badminton Rallies
cards.subtitle: Willie Stoffer Gymnasium · Hadlock Student Center
cards.notes: Check in with your university ID, ask staff about badminton equipment, and rotate partners so everyone gets court time.
cards.short_summary: Share a low-key badminton session on Hadlock’s first-come, first-served courts.
cards.evidence_claim: George Fox identifies badminton as an activity supported by Hadlock’s multi-use courts and directs patrons to ask the welcome desk for setup.
cards.access_notes: Available to eligible Hadlock members during posted hours; bring a current George Fox ID for entry and equipment checkout.

cards.title: Organize a Pickleball Rotation
cards.subtitle: Willie Stoffer Gymnasium · Hadlock Student Center
cards.notes: Ask the welcome desk for pickleball setup, claim an available court, and run short games so friends can rotate in.
cards.short_summary: Gather classmates for rotating pickleball games without buying court admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock’s official policies identify pickleball as a supported court activity and state that the gym is available first-come, first-served.
cards.access_notes: Eligible students need a signed campus waiver and current George Fox ID; inquire at the welcome desk for pickleball setup.

cards.entity_name: Roped Climbing at Hadlock Climbing Wall
cards.title: Climb the 40-Foot Wall
cards.subtitle: Hadlock Student Center · Indoor climbing facility
cards.notes: Bring your ID, complete required waivers, and confirm current climbing procedures with wall staff before gearing up.
cards.short_summary: Meet friends for roped climbing on Hadlock’s five-line indoor wall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock’s indoor climbing facility has five roped lines on a 40-foot wall, and eligible George Fox undergraduates have facility access.
cards.access_notes: Eligible students enter with a current university ID after signing the campus waiver; follow posted climbing-wall requirements.

cards.title: Try a Bouldering Session
cards.subtitle: Hadlock Student Center · 1,000-square-foot bouldering area
cards.notes: Check wall availability, follow staff instructions, and take turns working through routes with a small group.
cards.short_summary: Use Hadlock’s dedicated bouldering space for a collaborative climbing hang.
cards.evidence_claim: George Fox documents 1,000 square feet of bouldering space inside Hadlock, which is open to eligible current undergraduate students.
cards.access_notes: A current George Fox ID and signed campus waiver are required for eligible student access; observe climbing-area rules.

cards.entity_name: Indoor Track at Hadlock Student Center
cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track Together
cards.subtitle: Hadlock Student Center · Elevated track
cards.notes: Choose a comfortable pace, keep lanes clear for other users, and turn a study break into a conversation walk.
cards.short_summary: Walk or run with friends on an indoor track where ten laps equal one mile.
cards.evidence_claim: Hadlock provides an elevated indoor track for walking and running, and the facility is open to eligible current George Fox undergraduates.
cards.access_notes: Enter during posted Hadlock hours with a current George Fox ID after completing the required campus waiver.

cards.entity_name: GroupX Classes at Hadlock Student Center
cards.title: Reserve a GroupX Class Spot
cards.subtitle: Hadlock fitness studios · Advance registration required
cards.notes: Check the live IMLeagues schedule, reserve a place before the class fills, and bring non-marking athletic shoes.
cards.short_summary: Join a scheduled instructor-led workout with other eligible Hadlock users.
cards.evidence_claim: George Fox states that GroupX classes are free to anyone with Hadlock access and that participants must register in advance through IMLeagues.
cards.access_notes: Free for people with Hadlock access; advance IMLeagues registration is mandatory, and current undergraduates receive priority.

cards.entity_name: Exercise Coaching at Hadlock Student Center
cards.title: Book an Exercise-Coaching Session
cards.subtitle: Hadlock Student Center · Eligible campus users
cards.notes: Use the fitness-program contact or registration route to arrange a session, then bring goals you want to work through.
cards.short_summary: Turn a free coaching appointment into a shared accountability session.
cards.evidence_claim: George Fox states that undergraduate students and fee-paying graduate students have free access to exercise-coaching sessions.
cards.access_notes: Free for undergraduate and fee-paying graduate students; confirm the current booking process with University Recreation.

cards.entity_name: Open Swim at Chehalem Aquatic & Fitness Center
cards.title: Meet for a Pool Session
cards.subtitle: Chehalem Aquatic & Fitness Center · Adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Show your George Fox ID at the front desk, confirm the current pool schedule, and choose an open-swim period.
cards.short_summary: Use George Fox’s student-access benefit for a social swim beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Current traditional undergraduates and students in specified Newberg-based graduate programs receive free access to Chehalem Aquatic & Fitness Center by showing a George Fox student ID.
cards.access_notes: Show a current George Fox student ID at the aquatic-center front desk; the benefit excludes spouses and family members.
